info.name: FixItNow API
info.description:
Home services marketplace backend. Auth is via HttpOnly cookie — log in once with the Login request in this collection and Postman will keep sending the cookie automatically on later requests in the same session.

Set the {{baseUrl}} collection variable to your local or deployed URL (e.g. http://localhost:5000/api or https://your-app.vercel.app/api) before running requests.
